title: Native Brep Kernel and Vcs Brep Document
description: Rewrite kernel/3d/brep/rs (currently kernel_3d_brepkit, a wrapper over six external brepkit-* git crates plus async-trait/rayon/base64) into a full-blown, dependency-free, feature-complete native B-Rep solid modeling kernel, renamed kernel_3d_brep. Strategy: additive build — new src/*.rs modules (math, tolerance, robust predicates with exact-rational escalation via mathematical_number, polynomial/bezier/bspline, analytic+NURBS curves and surfaces, generational-arena topology (vertex/edge/coedge/loop/face/shell/solid) with first-class pcurves, Euler operators, validation, BVH, point classification, curve/curve + curve/surface + surface/surface intersection, face imprint/arrangement, a proper intersect->split->classify->select->stitch Boolean pipeline (not triangle clipping), sewing, primitives, sweeps (extrude/revolve/loft/pipe/helical), offsets/shell/draft, rolling-ball fillets/chamfers, healing/defeature, crack-free tessellation, mass properties via divergence theorem, operation history (generated/modified/deleted deltas), hand-rolled STEP (ISO 10303-21) + STL/OBJ/GLB IO, and a brute-force oracle module for differential testing — are added file by file while the old brepkit wrapper keeps compiling and serving consumers unchanged. Only in the final "Flip" phase: delete the old wrapper code, rename the crate, drop all external deps (brepkit-*, async-trait, rayon, base64, kernel_3d_engine), dissolve the kernel_3d_engine trait crate in favor of a typed synchronous Brep struct API, and refactor all 9 consumer crates (flow/module/brep, cad/plugin, process/plugin, framework/product/os/core, kernel/3d/spatial, procedural/plugin, protocol/module/procedural, flow/core, lowpoly/core). Then add a fully VCS-integrated .brep document layer inside the same crate: a DSL-printable BrepProjection (bodies/topology/geometry tables), a two-layer BrepOperation (readable parametric feature ops like BoxSolid/Extrude/Fuse/FilletEdges, each carrying a recorded TopologyDelta of generated/modified/deleted entity snapshots captured from the kernel's operation journal for exact backwards() inversion and kernel-free deterministic replay), a handcrafted brep_text DSL/OpText module (impl vcs::DocumentDsl + vcs::OpText, following the lowpoly/core/rs handcrafted-text-module pattern, not the derive macros), and a BrepComputeSession mirroring LowpolyDocument. Registration: remove kernel/3d/brep/engine/rs from the workspace, rename the nx project to @semio-tech/kernel-3d-brep, add a lint target, add a 🧪️test🧊️kernel-3d-brep entry to .vscode/launch.json, update all consumer Cargo.toml deps. Test strategy mirrors mathematical/wfc/rs: inline tests per module in fundamental/quick/long/exhaustive tiers, a brute-force SDF/mass-property/watertightness oracle built early, differential-equivalence gates (fast analytic path vs marching/reference path), volume-additivity and validate-clean invariants for every boolean/sweep/feature, adversarial numeric cases (near-tangent, coincident, extreme scale). Every phase must leave `cargo test --workspace` green except the single declared big-bang "Flip" phase that swaps all consumers over at once. Full plan on disk at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/make-a-plan-for-linear-cosmos.md.
